verses.1: You who dwell in the shelter of the Most High, who abide in the shadow of the Almighty,
verses.2: Say to the LORD, "My refuge and fortress, my God in whom I trust."
verses.3: God will rescue you from the fowler's snare, from the destroying plague,
verses.4: Will shelter you with pinions, spread wings that you may take refuge; God's faithfulness is a protecting shield.
verses.5: You shall not fear the terror of the night nor the arrow that flies by day,
verses.6: Nor the pestilence that roams in darkness, nor the plague that ravages at noon.
verses.7: Though a thousand fall at your side, ten thousand at your right hand, near you it shall not come.
verses.8: You need simply watch; the punishment of the wicked you will see.
verses.9: You have the LORD for your refuge; you have made the Most High your stronghold.
verses.10: No evil shall befall you, no affliction come near your tent.
verses.11: For God commands the angels to guard you in all your ways.
verses.12: With their hands they shall support you, lest you strike your foot against a stone.
verses.13: You shall tread upon the asp and the viper, trample the lion and the dragon.
verses.14: Whoever clings to me I will deliver; whoever knows my name I will set on high.
verses.15: All who call upon me I will answer; I will be with them in distress; I will deliver them and give them honor.
verses.16: With length of days I will satisfy them and show them my saving power.

notes.text: The shelter of the Most High: basically "hiding place" but in the psalms a designation for the protected temple precincts. Cf Psalm 27:5; 31:21; 61:5. The shadow of the Almighty: literally, "the shadow of the wings of the Almighty." Cf Psalm 17:8; 36:8; 57:2; 63:8. Psalm 91:4 makes clear that the shadow is an image of the safety afforded by the outstretched wings of the cherubim in the holy of holies.
The words are cited in Luke 4:10-11; Matthew 4:6, as Satan tempts Jesus in the desert.
